explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/111: for every graph with chromatic cardinal ℵ_1, h_G(n)/n → ∞. h_G(n) is the maximum, over n-vertex sets S, of the minimum number of edges whose deletion makes G[S] bipartite. Using induced subgraphs is right, because the induced subgraph needs the most deletions among subgraphs on S. The set defining the supremum is nonempty and bounded by C(n,2), since an ℵ_1-chromatic graph is uncountable.
